# Terms for suggestions to {{PRODUCT_NAME}}

DRAFT. Not legal advice. Replace this text with terms you stand behind.

These are the terms under which anyone may send a suggestion about {{PRODUCT_NAME}}
(the "Product") to {{OWNER_NAME}} (the "Owner"). A suggestion is an idea, a bug report, a
piece of content or any other improvement you send through the public inbox at
{{INBOX_URL}}. By typing "I agree" you accept these terms, and a signed record of that is
kept with your suggestion. If you do not agree, do not send a suggestion.

## 1. What you give

You keep whatever rights you have in your suggestion. You grant the Owner a worldwide,
perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, non-exclusive, sublicensable license to use, copy,
modify, adapt, publish and distribute your suggestion, and any work the Owner builds from
it, as part of the Product and under the Product's license ({{PRODUCT_LICENSE}}, for
example the Ferryman Source-Available License), in any form and by any means.

## 2. No obligation

The Owner does not have to review, answer, accept, build, ship or keep your suggestion,
and may build something similar on their own. Sending a suggestion creates no
partnership, employment, agency, confidentiality or other relationship.

## 3. No payment

Nothing is owed to you for a suggestion or for anything built from it, unless the Owner
says so in writing: {{PAYMENT_STATEMENT, for example "No payment is offered."}}

## 4. Credit

If the Owner builds and releases something from your suggestion, they will credit you by
the GitHub login you signed it with, in {{CREDITS_LOCATION}}. Credit is the reward. You
may ask not to be credited by telling the Owner in the suggestion's thread.

## 5. You have the right to send it

You promise that the suggestion is your own idea or that you have the right to send it,
that it does not include anyone else's copyrighted work, trade secrets, code, assets,
personal data or confidential information, and that you will not send any secret or
credential. Send the idea in words; do not send code or files.

## 6. Idea submission acknowledgement

You understand that the Owner may already have, or may later receive from others, ideas
like yours; that the Owner may develop and release them without owing you anything; and
that your suggestion is not confidential.

## 7. Terms change

The Owner may publish new terms. A new version applies to suggestions sent after you
agree to it. Ferryman checks which version you agreed to and asks you to agree again
when the terms change. Until you do, nothing new is built from a suggestion you sent
under an older version.

## 8. Everything else

These terms are governed by {{GOVERNING_LAW}}. Disputes go to {{VENUE}}. If a part of
these terms cannot be enforced, the rest still applies. Questions: {{CONTACT_EMAIL}}.
